searchText: Do client teams want to trigger eof with `osakaTime` ? Could we do something like `eofTime` - at least until we are not 100% that eof will be in osaka? We are 100% sure that EOF is going in Osake and that it will be Osaka first EIP. It make sense to use `osakaTime`. Ok we can make adjustments to all our tooling for osakaTime then. <@758579010027782144> and for nethermind it should stick to `eip7692TransitionTimestamp` ? <@360491619402776577> can you pls ensure that geth is modified to be active with osakaTime? <@316280621783580673> 🙂 but generally, yes - we active all eips in this way Fusaka support for ethereum genesis generator: https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-genesis-generator/pull/152 Fusaka support for kurtosis ethereum package: https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/pull/798 ^ pre-requisite is to have a rebase on top of alpha 8 spec - latest [7002 and 7251 contracts](https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-genesis-generator/pull/151)

excerpts.content:
Do client teams want to trigger eof with `osakaTime` ? 

Could we do something like `eofTime`  - at least until we are not 100% that eof will be in osaka?

excerpts.author: draganrakita
excerpts.content: We are 100% sure that EOF is going in Osake and that it will be Osaka first EIP. It make sense to use `osakaTime`.
